## 0. AI MODEL DIRECTIVE (SYSTEM PROMPT FOR ALL AI AGENTS)

When any AI model (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, or Google AI Studio) generates course content, HTML, CSS, React apps, MS Word templates, PowerPoint decks, or video blueprints for **Learn:Blended**, it MUST strictly enforce these **10 Core Laws**:

1. **The Clean White Reading Canvas Law (LMS, Word & Print):** Long-form learning content MUST use a **Pure White (`#FFFFFF`) background with crisp Dark Reading Ink (`#222222`) body text**. Never place multi-sentence paragraphs inside heavy dark or colored boxes. Use brand colors (`#4682B4` Steel Blue, `#6DC082` Emerald Green, `#D5E3EF` Soft Ice Blue, `#EAF6ED` Mint Ice) strictly as **structured visual enhancement blocks, callout borders, section headers, symbol cards, and summary tables** that break up the white page and guide the learner's eye.
2. **The Strict Flatness Law:** `box-shadow: none` across all mediums. Never use drop shadows, text shadows, 3D bevels, skeuomorphic gradients, or neon glows in HTML, CSS, PowerPoint, Word, or Video. Depth and hierarchy are created strictly through solid borders (`1px` to `6px`), soft tint fills (`#F4F8FB`, `#D5E3EF`, `#EAF6ED`), and nested container spacing.
3. **The Corner Geometry Law:**
   * **Video & Hero Outer Containers:** `20px` border-radius (`4mm` in Print/Word).
   * **LMS Callout Cards & Inner Nested Panels:** `16px` border-radius (`3mm` in Print/Word).
   * **Inline Badges, Pills & Table Wrappers:** `8px` to `12px` border-radius (`2mm` in Print/Word).
4. **The Single Font Law:** **Roboto** (`font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif`) is the exclusive typeface across all digital, video, and print channels.
5. **The Dual-Color Semantic & Instructional Symbol Routing Law:**
   * **Steel Blue (`#4682B4`)** signals **Structure, Authority, Navigation, Statutory Law, Practical Tasks, Incident Analysis, and Assessment**. When generating **Block 2 Steel Blue Callouts** (`#4682B4` border, `#F4F8FB` fill), pair strictly with these 6 Steel Blue instructional symbols:
     1. `Practical.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Practical.png`) — Hands-on workplace drills, physical floor tasks, or PoE logbook activities.
     2. `Assessment.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Assessment.png`) — Formative knowledge checks, summative PoE tasks, or EISA exam checkpoints.
     3. `Information.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Information.png`) — Essential workplace rules, key definitions, or compliance "Good to Know" notes.
     4. `MS-Teams.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/MS-Teams.png`) — Scheduled live virtual sessions hosted on Microsoft Teams.
     5. `Case-Study.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Case-Study.png`) — Real-world workplace scenarios, industry incident analyses, or applied business examples.
     6. `High-Importance.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/High-Importance.png`) — Critical safety warnings, mandatory statutory compliance requirements, or non-negotiable workplace rules.
   * **Emerald Green (`#6DC082` graphics / `#1E7E34` accessible text)** signals **Action, Positive Payoff, Reflection, Self-Evaluation, Multimedia, and LMS Portal Tasks**. When generating **Block 3 Emerald Green Callouts** (`#6DC082` border, `#EAF6ED` fill), pair strictly with these 5 Emerald Green instructional symbols:
     7. `LMS.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/LMS.png`) — Directs learner to an online quiz, upload, or lesson inside BrainCert LMS.
     8. `Learner-Guide.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Learner-Guide.png`) — Cross-reference to read a section, review a table, or complete a worksheet in the printed/PDF Learner Guide.
     9. `Discussion.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Discussion.png`) — Triggers group discussion, peer reflection, or facilitator-led classroom Q&A.
     10. `Video.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Video.png`) — Directs learner to watch an instructional video clip, screencast, or demonstration before continuing.
     11. `Reflect.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/Reflect.png`) — Prompts learners to pause, self-evaluate, and connect new concepts to their own workplace experience.
   * **Master Brand Monogram:** `LB-Logo.png` (`https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/symbols/LB-Logo.png`) — Official Learn:Blended rounded monogram for headers, covers, and portal navbars.
   * **Validation Red (`#D9534F`)** is restricted strictly to **Error States, "Wrong Way" contrast blocks, and Quiz Feedback**—never decorative.
6. **The WCAG Contrast Law:** Never render small or medium text in `#6DC082` (Emerald Green) on a white background (contrast is 2.35:1). Always use `#6DC082` for **borders, badges, and graphical icons**, and pair it with **`#1E7E34` (Dark Emerald)** for green headings/labels and **`#222222` (Reading Ink)** for body copy.
7. **The South African Floor-Level Voice Law:** Write in direct, honest South African English (UK/SA spelling: *programme, organisation, labour, practise/practice*) at a **Grade 7–8 reading level**. Address the learner as *"you/your"* using a supportive workplace coach tone, never an academic examiner tone.
8. **The No Legal Disclaimer Law:** Never insert legal disclaimers (such as *"Training content, not formal legal advice"*) in videos, BrainCert HTML lessons, PowerPoint slides, or printed manuals. The brand maintains authoritative, defensible training content without cluttering learning surfaces with disclaimers.
9. **The Bold-Prefix / Regular-Body Law:** Never bold an entire sentence inside interactive options (`Option A/B/C`), accordion headers (`Click to Reveal`), numbered process steps, or bullet lists. Always style the **Lead-In Prefix** (`Option A:`, `Step 1:`, `💡 Click to Reveal:`) in **Roboto Bold (`700`)** using **Steel Blue (`#4682B4`)** or **Dark Emerald (`#1E7E34`)**, and style the **sentence following the colon** in **Roboto Regular (`400`)** using **Dark Reading Ink (`#222222`)**.
10. **The Visual Illustration & Character Law:** Whenever an AI model generates or prompts for illustrations, scenario graphics, or character avatars across BrainCert HTML, PowerPoint, MS Word manuals, or Hyperframes Block D, it MUST enforce the **Learn:Blended 3D Realistic Pixar Aesthetic**: authentic South African workplace diversity, employees dressed in **Emerald Green (`#6DC082`) collared golf shirts and light blue denim jeans**, set in realistic South African work environments (warehouses, receiving bays, retail floors, offices) with subtle **Steel Blue (`#4682B4`) and Emerald Green (`#6DC082`)** architectural and equipment accents.

## 1. IDENTITY, VOICE & COMPLIANCE GOVERNANCE

### 1.1 Identity & Mission
Learn:Blended provides affordable, legally grounded, and highly engaging microlearning and QCTO-aligned occupational training for South African SMEs and frontline teams, delivered through branded online learning portals (BrainCert Enterprise LMS) and blended classroom/workplace workshops.

### 1.2 Vocabulary Guardrails
* **BANNED Corporate Jargon:** *synergy, circle back, north star, empowerment journeys, deep dive, low-hanging fruit, paradigm shift, leverage*.
* **BANNED Compliance Vocabulary:** *guaranteed, flawless, CCMA-proof, legally bulletproof, 100% compliant, immune to claims*.
* **APPROVED Compliance Vocabulary:** *supports, audit-ready, system-generated, POPIA-aligned, helps you prepare, defensible workplace practice*.

### 1.3 Localized South African Reality Anchors
Every training scenario, case study, and practical drill must reflect authentic South African workplace conditions: taxi strikes and public transport delays, load reduction/cable theft, warehouse receiving bay bottlenecks, scanner/equipment failure, CCMA disputes, LRA/BCEA procedures, and SETA/WSP deadline season.

| **Red Ice Tint** | `#FDF2F2` | `253, 242, 242` | `0, 8, 6, 0` | Tint | **`4% K` Screen Tint** | Subtle background fill for Validation Red mistake/warning boxes |

| **H3 / Block Title** | `30–34px` | `16px` (`Uppercase`) | `11.5pt` (`Before: 8pt, After: 2pt`)| `18pt` / `20pt` | Bold/Black (`700`/`900`), `#4682B4` or `#1E7E34` |
| **Body Copy** | `26–32px` (`#4A4A4A`) | `16px` (`#222222`, `LH: 1.65`) | `10.5pt` (`#222222`, `LH: 1.35`) | `16pt`–`20pt` (`#222222`) | Regular (`400`), Reading Ink `#222222` (Video: `#4A4A4A`) |

## 4. BRAINCERT LMS HTML DESIGN SYSTEM (CLEAN WHITE CANVAS + VISUAL BLOCKS)

### 4.1 Pedagogical Layout Rhythm for BrainCert Lessons
When authoring HTML lessons for BrainCert Enterprise LMS, AI models must never output unstyled walls of text or dark/heavy full-page backgrounds. Follow this strict **White-Canvas Rhythm**:
1. **Base Canvas:** Pure White (`#FFFFFF`) container (`max-width: 840px`), `16px` Roboto Regular body copy in crisp Dark Reading Ink (`#222222`), line-height `1.65`.
2. **Pacing Rule:** After every **2 short paragraphs (max 80–100 words)** of black-on-white reading text, insert a **Visual Enhancement Block** (Symbol Callout, Numbered Step Grid, Wrong/Right Contrast, Statutory Quote, Comparison Table, or Interactive Click-to-Reveal Check) to anchor comprehension visually.
3. **The Bold-Prefix / Regular-Body Law:** Never bold an entire sentence inside interactive options (`Option A/B/C`), accordion headers (`Click to Reveal`), numbered process steps, or bullet lists. Always style the **Lead-In Prefix** (`Option A:`, `Step 1:`, `💡 Click to Reveal:`) in **Roboto Bold (`700`)** using **Steel Blue (`#4682B4`)** or **Dark Emerald (`#1E7E34`)**, and style the **sentence following the colon** in **Roboto Regular (`400`)** using **Dark Reading Ink (`#222222`)**.
4. **BrainCert HTML Pasting Rule (Code-View Governance):** Always paste and edit Learn:Blended HTML blocks inside BrainCert's **Code View (`</>`)** and save directly. Interactive `<details>`/`<summary>` blocks include explicit `display: list-item` and visual `[Check ▾]` / `[Reveal ▾]` badges to override BrainCert's Bootstrap CSS reset. *Note: Interactive HTML blocks are designed for instant formative self-checking during a lesson; use BrainCert's native Testing Engine for graded markbook assessments.*

### 4.2 The Canonical BrainCert Inline HTML Templates

#### Block 1: Lesson Wrapper & Module Title Banner
```html
<div style="background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #222222; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 840px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; box-sizing: border-box;">

  <!-- MODULE TITLE BANNER -->
  <div style="border-bottom: 3px solid #4682B4; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 24px;">
    <div style="display: inline-block; background-color: #D5E3EF; color: #4682B4; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
      Module 1 • Unit 1.1
    </div>
    <h1 style="color: #4682B4; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900; margin: 0; line-height: 1.25;">
      Checking Stock Carefully Before You Sign the Delivery Note
    </h1>
  </div>

  <!-- CLEAN WHITE-BACKGROUND READING PARAGRAPH -->
  <p style="margin: 0 0 16px 0; color: #222222;">
    When a delivery truck arrives at the receiving bay during a busy morning shift, the driver will often rush you to sign the delivery note immediately. If you sign before counting the actual boxes on the pallet, your company becomes legally responsible for any missing or damaged stock.
  </p>

</div>
```

#### Block 2: Steel Blue Symbol Callout (`Practical.png`, `Assessment.png`, `Information.png`, `MS-Teams.png`, `Case-Study.png`, `High-Importance.png`)

<div style="display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; background-color: #F4F8FB; border: 2px solid #4682B4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px 20px; margin: 22px 0; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box;">

    <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4682B4; letter-spacing: 0.6px; margin-bottom: 4px;">

#### Block 4: Statutory Authority & Plain-English Translation Card (Mirrors Video Block QUOTE)
```html
<div style="background-color: #D5E3EF; border-left: 6px solid #4682B4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; margin: 22px 0; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box;">
  <p style="font-size: 17px; font-style: italic; color: #4682B4; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 6px 0; line-height: 1.45;">
    "Every employer shall provide and maintain, as far as is reasonably practicable, a working environment that is safe and without risk to the health of his employees."
  </p>
  <div style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #4682B4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
    — Occupational Health and Safety Act 85 of 1993, Section 8(1)
  </div>
  <div style="background-color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: #222222; border: 1px solid #83ADCF; line-height: 1.5;">
    <strong style="color: #1E7E34;">What this means on the floor:</strong> You must keep walkways clear of loose shrink-wrap and broken pallets so nobody trips while carrying stock.
  </div>
</div>
```

#### Block 5: Two-Column "Common Mistake vs. Audit-Ready Practice" Contrast (Mirrors Video Block B)
```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin: 22px 0; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box;">
  <!-- Left: Mistake (Validation Red) -->
  <div style="flex: 1 1 280px; background-color: #FDF2F2; border: 2px solid #D9534F; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px;">
    <div style="color: #D9534F; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
      ✗ Common Floor Mistake
    </div>
    <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.5;">
      Signing the driver's POD (Proof of Delivery) first and planning to check the boxes later when the bay is quiet.
    </p>
  </div>
  <!-- Right: Audit-Ready Practice (Emerald Green) -->
  <div style="flex: 1 1 280px; background-color: #EAF6ED; border: 2px solid #6DC082; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px;">
    <div style="color: #1E7E34; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
      ✓ Audit-Ready Practice
    </div>
    <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.5;">
      Checking seal numbers, counting every carton against the Purchase Order, noting shortages in ink, and signing last.
    </p>
  </div>
</div>
```

#### Block 6: Numbered Step-by-Step Process Cards (Bold Prefix + Regular Body)
```html
<div style="margin: 22px 0; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box;">
  <h2 style="color: #4682B4; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 12px 0;">
    The 3-Step Receiving Check
  </h2>
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #83ADCF; border-left: 6px solid #4682B4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
    <div style="background-color: #4682B4; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;">1</div>
    <div style="font-size: 15.5px; color: #222222;"><strong style="color: #4682B4; font-weight: 700;">Match the Paperwork:</strong> Check that the supplier invoice matches your company Purchase Order number.</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #83ADCF; border-left: 6px solid #4682B4; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
    <div style="background-color: #4682B4; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;">2</div>
    <div style="font-size: 15.5px; color: #222222;"><strong style="color: #4682B4; font-weight: 700;">Inspect & Count Stock:</strong> Count every unit physically and check for water damage, broken seals, or expired dates.</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Step 3 (Emerald Payoff Step) -->
  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background-color: #EAF6ED; border: 1.5px solid #6DC082; border-left: 6px solid #6DC082; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px;">
    <div style="background-color: #1E7E34; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;">3</div>
    <div style="font-size: 15.5px; color: #222222;"><strong style="color: #1E7E34; font-weight: 700;">Record & Sign:</strong> Write any variances on the Goods Received Voucher (GRV) and get the driver to counter-sign.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

      <span style="float: right; background-color: #D5E3EF; color: #4682B4; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; margin-left: 8px;">Check ▾</span>
    </summary>
    <div style="background-color: #FDF2F2; border-top: 2px solid #D9534F; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; line-height: 1.55;">

        ✗ Incorrect — Why This Puts the Store at Risk
      </strong>

    </div>

      <span style="float: right; background-color: #D5E3EF; color: #4682B4; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; margin-left: 8px;">Check ▾</span>
    </summary>
    <div style="background-color: #EAF6ED; border-top: 2px solid #6DC082; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; line-height: 1.55;">
      <strong style="color: #1E7E34; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px;">
        ✓ Correct — Audit-Ready Floor Practice
      </strong>
      Recording the exact variance on the delivery note and Goods Received Voucher (GRV) with the driver's counter-signature gives Procurement solid proof for a credit note.
    </div>
  </details>

  <!-- Option C: Incorrect -->
  <details style="border: 1.5px solid #83ADCF; border-radius: 12px; background-color: #F4F8FB; overflow: hidden;">
    <summary style="display: list-item; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; cursor: pointer; outline: none; line-height: 1.5;">
      <strong style="color: #4682B4; font-weight: 700;">Option C:</strong> Accept all 12 cartons quietly and throw the 2 damaged cartons in the skip.
      <span style="float: right; background-color: #D5E3EF; color: #4682B4; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; margin-left: 8px;">Check ▾</span>
    </summary>
    <div style="background-color: #FDF2F2; border-top: 2px solid #D9534F; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #222222; line-height: 1.55;">
      <strong style="color: #D9534F; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px;">
        ✗ Incorrect — Never Destroy Stock Evidence
      </strong>

    </div>

</div>

## 5. MS WORD (`.DOCX`) & PRINTED MATTER SPECIFICATION

### 5.1 Page Geometry & Ring-Binder Gutter Rules
* **Paper Format:** Standard ISO **A4 (`210mm × 297mm`)** for Learner Guides, Facilitator Manuals, Workplace Logbooks, and PoE Assessment Workbooks; **A5 (`148mm × 210mm`)** for laminated pocket reference cards.
* **Margins:**
  * **Top / Bottom:** `20mm`
  * **Outer Edge:** `18mm`
  * **Inner (Binding Gutter) Edge:** `25mm` (18mm margin + 7mm ring-binder/comb-punch clearance so hole-punching never clips symbol icons or table borders).
* **Print Bleed (Covers Only):** `3mm` full bleed (`216mm × 303mm`) exported as PDF/X-1a at `300 DPI`.

### 5.2 MS Word Style Sheet Mapping
When generating `.docx` files programmatically (via `python-docx`, `docx-js`, or Word Templates), define these exact paragraph styles:
* `Normal (Body)`: Roboto Regular `10.5pt`, Color `#222222`, Line Spacing `1.25`, Space After `6pt`.
* `Heading 1 (Module Title)`: Roboto Black `20pt`, Color `#4682B4`, Space Before `0pt`, Space After `8pt`, Bottom Border `2.25pt` solid `#4682B4`.
* `Heading 2 (Unit Sub-heading)`: Roboto Bold `14pt`, Color `#4682B4`, Space Before `14pt`, Space After `4pt`, `Keep with next = True`.
* `Heading 3 (Activity Heading)`: Roboto Bold `11.5pt`, Color `#1E7E34` (or `#222222`), Space Before `8pt`, Space After `2pt`, `Keep with next = True`.
* `Header`: `8.5pt` Roboto Regular `#696969`. Left: Qualification / Module Title. Right: `LB-Logo.png` (`9mm` height). Bottom border `0.75pt` solid `#83ADCF`.
* `Footer`: `8.5pt` Roboto Regular `#696969`. Left: Qualification / Module Code & Version. Right: `Page X of Y` + Learn:Blended Monogram (no legal disclaimer).

### 5.3 MS Word Callout Box Construction (Non-Breaking 2-Column Table Rule)
Never use floating Word textboxes (they shift and break across pages). Always build symbol callout boxes in MS Word as a **1-Row, 2-Column Table** with `CantSplit` (*"Allow row to break across pages" = OFF*):
* **Column 1 (Icon Cell):** Width `22mm`, vertical alignment `Center`, containing the Symbol PNG (`14mm × 14mm`).
* **Column 2 (Text Cell):** Width `145mm`, cell padding Top/Bottom `3mm`, Left/Right `4mm`.
* **Monochrome Laser Print Compatibility:** Because many manuals are printed on black-and-white laser printers (e.g., Canon i-SENSYS LBP252dw), Emerald Green callouts use a **`4.5pt` solid left border + `1.5pt` outer border** and `#EAF6ED` (`5% K` tint), while Steel Blue callouts use a **uniform `1.5pt` outer border** and `#F4F8FB` (`3% K` tint), making them visually distinct even without color ink.

---

## 6. POWERPOINT (16:9) CLASSROOM PRESENTATION SPECIFICATION

* **Slide Dimensions:** Widescreen 16:9 (`33.867 cm × 19.05 cm` / `1920×1080px`).
* **Stage Geometry (Mirrors Hyperframes Option A):**
  * **Slide Background:** Solid Steel Blue `#4682B4` (with optional flat organic corner vector blobs in `#D5E3EF` and `#6DC082`).
  * **Dominant White Slide Card:** Pure White `#FFFFFF` rounded rectangle (`1860×1020px`, centered, inset `30px` from all screen edges, `20px` corner radius, strictly flat with zero drop shadow).
  * **The 5px Nesting Rule:** Nested internal panels obey `16px` corner radius, `5px` outer perimeter gap facing the card edge, and a flush `5px` white divider between sibling panels.

### 6.1 The 5 Canonical PowerPoint 16:9 Slide Layouts

#### Layout 1: Module Title & Hook Slide (Mirrors Block A Architecture)
* **Canvas:** Full-width white card (`1860×1020px`), `60px` internal padding.
* **Top Bar:** `LB-Logo.png` (`90×90px`) top-left; Module/SAQA Qualification Pill (`#D5E3EF` background, `#4682B4` bold `14pt` uppercase text, `8px` radius) top-right.
* **Center Hero:** Module Title in `44pt` Roboto Black (`900`) Steel Blue (`#4682B4`), maximum 2 lines.
* **Payoff Banner:** Nested bottom panel (`#EAF6ED` fill, `2px` `#6DC082` border, `16px` radius) containing the core workplace payoff statement in `22pt` Roboto Bold Dark Emerald (`#1E7E34`).
* **Footer:** Clean margin space (no legal disclaimers).

#### Layout 2: Core Concept & 4-Step Teaching Slide (Mirrors Block F Kinetic Workhorse)
* **Header Zone:** Top-left H1 (`32pt` Roboto Bold `#4682B4`) + concise 1-line context sub-header (`18pt` Roboto Regular `#4A4A4A`).
* **Body Zone (4 Horizontal Step Rows):** Maximum 4 stacked step cards (`height: 145px` each, `12px` vertical gap, `16px` radius).
  * **Steps 1–3 (Standard State):** `#F4F8FB` background, `1.5px` `#83ADCF` border, `6px` `#4682B4` left bar, `48×48px` `#4682B4` number badge (`1`, `2`, `3` in white `20pt` Black), `20pt` `#222222` text (max 12 words per row).
  * **Step 4 (Payoff State):** `#EAF6ED` background, `2px` `#6DC082` border, `6px` `#6DC082` left bar, `48×48px` `#1E7E34` checkmark/number badge, `20pt` `#1E7E34` bold payoff text.

#### Layout 3: Two-Sided Principle Contrast Slide (Mirrors Block B Split Architecture)
* **Outer Card Override:** Solid Steel Blue (`#4682B4`) dominant card with a `4px` crisp white border and `15px` blue inner frame.
* **50/50 Split Columns (5px gap):**
  * **Left Panel (Common Floor Mistake / False Belief):** Nested white card (`16px` radius, `2px` `#D9534F` border, `#FDF2F2` top header strip) with `20pt` `#D9534F` Bold header (`✗ COMMON FLOOR MISTAKE`) and `18pt` `#222222` scenario points.
  * **Right Panel (Audit-Ready Practice):** Nested white card (`16px` radius, `2px` `#6DC082` border, `#EAF6ED` top header strip) with `20pt` `#1E7E34` Bold header (`✓ AUDIT-READY PRACTICE`) and `18pt` `#222222` actionable steps.

#### Layout 4: Statutory Authority & Floor Translation Slide (Mirrors Block QUOTE)
* **Left Panel (55% width, nested 5px from left/top/bottom):** Soft Ice Blue (`#D5E3EF` at 85% opacity) panel (`16px` radius, `6px` `#4682B4` left border) containing verbatim Act/Section quote in `24pt` Roboto Italic `#4682B4` and uppercase citation badge (`14pt` Roboto Bold `#4682B4`).
* **Right Panel (45% width, separated by 5px white divider):** Pure White (`#FFFFFF`) panel with `Information.png` (`80×80px`) at top, heading `"WHAT THIS MEANS ON THE FLOOR"` (`18pt` Roboto Black `#1E7E34`), and plain-English frontline explanation (`18pt` Roboto Regular `#222222`).

#### Layout 5: Classroom Syndicate Drill / Practical Activity Slide (Blended Delivery)
* **Left Panel (35% width, nested 5px inset):** Solid Steel Blue (`#4682B4`) or Mint Ice (`#EAF6ED`) vertical card (`16px` radius) displaying the large Official Symbol (`Practical.png`, `Discussion.png`, `Learner-Guide.png`, or `LMS.png` at `160×160px` centered), Activity Type title (`22pt` Bold), and a Time Allocation Pill (e.g., `⏱ 15 MINUTES`).
* **Right Panel (65% width):** Pure White (`#FFFFFF`) workspace showing:
  1. **Your Task:** Numbered instructions (`18pt` `#222222`).
  2. **Reference:** Exact Learner Guide page or BrainCert LMS unit number.
  3. **Output / PoE Evidence:** Boxed footer (`#F4F8FB`, `1.5px` `#4682B4` border) stating exactly what the learner must write, submit, or present.

## 7. HYPERFRAMES STAGE & MOTION GRAMMAR (RATIFIED V8.1 RESTORATION)

### 7.1 The Stage (Option A Architecture)
* **Fixed Resolution:** `1920×1080`.
* **Canvas Background:** Steel Blue (`#4682B4`) carrying **four flat organic vector blobs** (White `#FFFFFF`, Soft-Ice `#D5E3EF`, Emerald `#6DC082`) in slow, loop-closed breathing (out-and-back sine cycle so cuts are seamless).
* **Dominant Card:** Pure White (`#FFFFFF`), inset **30px from every screen edge**, **20px corner radius**, `overflow: hidden`, strictly **flat (no drop shadows)**.

### 7.2 The 5px Nesting Rule
* Nested internal panels have **16px corner radius**.
* Maintain a **5px gap** facing the card's outer perimeter, and a flush **5px white divider** between sibling panels.
* **Block B Exception:** Block B uses a solid blue fill with a **4px crisp white border** around the card, plus a **15px blue frame** around the nested white panel.

### 7.3 Dedicated V8.1 Video Typographic & State Table

| Element Role | Video Font Size | Weight & Style | Color Token & State Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| **H1 / Slide Titles** | `48–56px` | Bold / Black (900) | Steel Blue `#4682B4` |
| **Kinetic Item Headers** | `36–40px` | Bold (700) | Starts Dim Gray `#4A4A4A` $\rightarrow$ transitions to Emerald `#6DC082` on horizontal fire (`+40px` right, scale `1.1`) |
| **Body & Sub-descriptions** | `26–32px` | Regular (400) | Dim Gray `#4A4A4A` / `#696969` |
| **Statutory Quotes** | `34–38px` | Roboto Italic (400) | Steel Blue `#4682B4` (Roboto Italic) |
| **Standard Caption Bar** | `26–28px` | Medium (500) | Background `#4682B4`, Text `#FFFFFF`, Active Word `#6DC082` (**Roboto Black 900 Underlined**) |
| **Inverted Caption Bar (Block B)** | `26–28px` | Medium (500) | Background `#FFFFFF`, Text `#4682B4`, Active Word `#1E7E34` (**Roboto Black 900 Underlined**) |

* **Caption Toggle:** Optional per-slide toggle (active on kinetic/avatar slides; OFF on hero/quote slides to maximize real estate).

### 7.4 Motion & Transitions
* **Stage Build (0:00):** White card descends from top with an `8px` micro-settle and initial entrance whoosh SFX.
* **Scene Transitions (Morphs):** The white card **persists continuously** throughout the lesson. Internal panels morph directionally:
  * White content panels enter/exit from top (`y: -15px`).
  * Blue dominant panels enter/exit from bottom (`y: +15px`).
  * Kinetic items fire horizontally (`+40px` right, scale `1.1`, Emerald `#6DC082` fire).
  * Inter-scene morphs are silent (no whooshes, no BGM).
* **Stage Close:** Lesson ends cleanly on **Block A (Consequence Payoff & Hand-off to Quiz)** with a final exit whoosh SFX (no legal disclaimers).

### 7.5 The Mandatory 8-Segment Pedagogical Lesson Arc & Slide Blocks Catalog

| Segment # | Slide Block Architecture | Course Pedagogical Job |
|---|---|---|
| **Segment 1** | **Block D (Avatar + Script)** | 60% blue script over 40% avatar holder (left), 70% white content (right), nested caption bar. *Job: Bridge from reflection poll into the theory lesson.* |
| **Segment 2** | **Block A or Block B** | **Block A** (Full-width white hero, no caption bar) to *destabilise a false belief*, OR **Block B** (Solid blue card, `4px` white border, `15px` blue frame around ~50% nested white panel, inverted caption bar) for *two-sided principle contrast*. |
| **Segment 3** | **Block F (Kinetic Workhorse)** | White card, title + kinetic list ($\le 4$ items firing horizontally `+40px` right, scale `1.1` into `#6DC082`) + standard caption bar. *Job: Core framework steps (Part 1).* |
| **Segment 4** | **Block F (Kinetic Workhorse)** | White card, title + kinetic list firing into Emerald + standard caption bar. *Job: Core framework steps (Part 2).* |
| **Segment 5** | **Block QUOTE (Statutory Authority)** | 85% translucent Soft Ice Blue (`#D5E3EF`) panel on left, `#4682B4` italic quote + citation, plain-English translation on right. No caption bar. *Job: Verbatim statutory legal anchor.* |
| **Segment 6** | **Block C (Split + Diagram)** | White-dominant left panel rendering **1 of 4 strict archetypes (`flow`, `comparison`, `matrix`, `loop`)**, blue panel right, nested caption bar. *Job: Conceptual framework visualization.* |
| **Segment 7** | **Block F (Kinetic Workhorse)** | Kinetic list replay with standard caption bar. *Job: Practical South African workplace scenario replay.* |
| **Segment 8** | **Block A (Single Hero Close)** | Full-width white card with `#4682B4` headline and `#6DC082` consequence payoff statement + final exit whoosh SFX (and hand-off to BrainCert quiz; zero legal disclaimers). |

### 7.6 Deterministic JSON Blueprint Contract
The AI Studio app generates a strictly validated JSON `Blueprint` where each segment specifies `block: "A" | "B" | "C" | "D" | "F" | "QUOTE"` and populates only the permitted slots:
1. `kineticItems` for Block F ($\le 4$ items).
2. `quoteText` and `statutoryCitation` for Block QUOTE.
3. `diagram` (`type: "flow" | "comparison" | "matrix" | "loop"`) for Block C.
4. `heroTitle` and `payoffStatement` for Block A.

## 8. CORPORATE WEB (WORDPRESS / KADENCE) & CUSTOM APP CODING (REACT / TAILWIND)

### 8.1 WordPress (Kadence Pro) 9-Slot Global Palette
* `Palette 1 (Primary Accent)`: `#4682B4` (Steel Blue)
* `Palette 2 (Secondary Accent)`: `#6DC082` (Emerald Green — buttons/accents)
* `Palette 3 (Strongest Heading/Body Text)`: `#222222` (Reading Ink)
* `Palette 4 (Secondary Body Text)`: `#4A4A4A` (Dim Gray)
* `Palette 5 (Muted / Meta Text)`: `#696969` (Muted Gray)
* `Palette 6 (Subtle Borders)`: `#83ADCF` (Light Blue)
* `Palette 7 (Alt Background 1)`: `#D5E3EF` (Soft Ice Blue)
* `Palette 8 (Alt Background 2)`: `#F4F8FB` (Blue Ice Tint)
* `Palette 9 (Base Canvas)`: `#FFFFFF` (Pure White)

### 8.2 Custom Web Apps & Classroom Tools (React / Tailwind CSS / HTML5)
When coding interactive classroom response tools, learner registration forms, or ePOE evaluation portals:
```css
:root {
  --lb-white: #FFFFFF;
  --lb-ink: #222222;
  --lb-charcoal: #4A4A4A;
  --lb-muted: #696969;
  --lb-blue: #4682B4;
  --lb-light-blue: #83ADCF;
  --lb-ice: #D5E3EF;
  --lb-ice-tint: #F4F8FB;
  --lb-emerald: #6DC082;
  --lb-dark-emerald: #1E7E34;
  --lb-mint-tint: #EAF6ED;
  --lb-red: #D9534F;
  --lb-red-tint: #FDF2F2;
  --lb-radius-card: 20px;
  --lb-radius-inner: 16px;
  --lb-radius-sm: 10px;
  --lb-font: 'Roboto', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif;
}
```
* **UI Component Rules:** All cards use `background: #FFFFFF`, `border: 2px solid #83ADCF` (or `#4682B4`), `border-radius: 16px`, and `box-shadow: none`. Primary buttons use `background: #4682B4; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 10px`. Confirm/Action buttons use `background: #1E7E34; color: #FFFFFF` (or `background: #6DC082; color: #222222; font-weight: 900`).

---

## 9. AI IMAGE, CHARACTER & SCENE GENERATION GOVERNANCE (V8.2)

### 9.1 Core Visual Aesthetic: "Realistic Pixar Studio 3D"
All custom illustrations, scenario headers, character avatars (including Hyperframes Block D), and manual graphics must share one unmistakable visual signature:
* **Render Style:** High-end **Realistic Pixar / Disney feature-animation 3D style**—warm cinematic global illumination, realistic subsurface skin textures, expressive friendly faces, natural human proportions (never big-headed chibi/caricature), and crisp depth-of-field.
* **Authentic South African Representation:** Characters must reflect the true demographic diversity of the South African workforce across age, gender, and heritage (Black, Coloured, Indian, and White South African team members working collaboratively).
* **BANNED Visual Tropes:** Generic flat 2D corporate "Memphis/Algeria" vector art, cold stock photography of American skyscrapers, dollar signs (`$` instead of `R` / ZAR), left-hand-drive trucks, or gloomy/gritty industrial lighting.

### 9.2 Mandatory Employee Wardrobe & Uniform Standard
To make every Learn:Blended learner immediately identify the protagonist on screen or in print:
* **Top (Mandatory):** Clean, well-fitted **Emerald Green (`#6DC082`) short-sleeve collared golf shirt / polo shirt** (optionally featuring the subtle Learn:Blended `lb` monogram on the left chest).
* **Bottoms (Mandatory):** Neat, practical **light blue denim jeans** (`#83ADCF` to classic light-wash indigo tone).
* **Role-Specific PPE Add-Ons (When in Warehouse / Dispatch / Receiving Scenarios):**
  * High-visibility reflective safety vest worn *open* over the Emerald Green golf shirt (or safety harness straps that still leave the Emerald Green shirt clearly visible).
  * Steel-toe safety boots, clipboard with Goods Received Voucher (GRV), or handheld barcode scanner.

### 9.3 Subtle Brand-Aligned Work Environment Rules
The background environment must feel like a real, tidy South African SME workplace (warehouse receiving bay, retail store backroom, dispatch desk, or training room) while subtly echoing the Learn:Blended color palette:
* **Steel Blue (`#4682B4`) Environmental Accents:** Warehouse pallet racking uprights, painted floor walkway border lines, noticeboard frames, folders, or office feature trim.
* **Emerald Green (`#6DC082`) & Soft Ice Blue (`#D5E3EF`) Accents:** Safety signage headers, storage bins, directional arrows, or sunlit wall panels.
* **South African Environmental Anchors:** Standard wooden CHEP-style pallets, brown corrugated cartons, roller-shutter receiving doors, South African 3-pin plugs/equipment, and local signage in UK/SA English.

### 9.4 Recurring Instructional Character Cast (Consistent Persona Reference)
When generating multi-part courses or Hyperframes Block D avatar scenes, maintain continuity using the established Learn:Blended cast:
* **Siya:** Friendly Black South African male warehouse/receiving clerk (early 30s, short neat fade, warm confident expression, wearing the Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Tumi:** Approachable Black South African female operations/inventory coordinator (late 20s, braided hair tied back neatly, holding clipboard/scanner, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Lauren:** Organised Coloured South African female HR / admin / retail supervisor (30s, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, warm coach demeanour, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Sipho:** Experienced Black South African male forklift/dispatch team leader (40s, short beard with a touch of grey, calm mentor presence, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Gail:** Practical White South African female office/procurement administrator (40s, glasses, friendly professional smile, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Lerato:** Energetic young Black South African female junior store person / learner (early 20s, curious engaged expression, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).
* **Thabo:** Detail-oriented Black South African male dispatch & receiving clerk (late 20s, inspecting stock labels carefully, Emerald Green golf shirt and light blue jeans).

### 9.5 Deterministic AI Image Prompt Formula (Copy-Paste Template for Any Image AI)
Whenever an AI generates an image prompt for Imagen, Midjourney, DALL-E, or Antigravity, it must construct the prompt using this exact 5-part formula:

> **Master Prompt Template:**  
> *"Realistic 3D Pixar movie animation style, medium shot of **[Character Description & Diverse South African Team Member(s)]** wearing a crisp **emerald green (`#6DC082`) collared golf shirt and light blue denim jeans**, actively **[Specific Workplace Action / Scenario]** inside a bright, tidy South African **[Workplace Setting: e.g., warehouse receiving bay / retail stockroom / SME office]**. The environment features subtle **steel blue (`#4682B4`)** pallet racking and painted floor lines, with **soft ice blue (`#D5E3EF`)** wall accents and warm natural daylight. Expressive friendly faces, cinematic Pixar lighting, ultra-clean 3D textures, shallow depth of field, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text overlays."*

### 9.6 Embedding Generated Images in BrainCert HTML & MS Word (Container Rule)
Generated scenario images must never float unframed or use drop shadows. Always wrap scenario illustrations inside the **V8.2 Flat Image Frame** (`16px` border-radius, `2px solid #83ADCF` border, optional `#F4F8FB` caption bar):

```html
<!-- BRAINCERT HTML SCENARIO IMAGE BLOCK -->
<div style="background-color: #F4F8FB; border: 2px solid #83ADCF; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; margin: 22px 0; font-family: 'Roboto', Arial, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box;">
  <img src="https://obronie.github.io/learnblended-brand/assets/scenario-placeholder.jpg" alt="South African workplace scenario" style="width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0;" />
  <div style="padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; color: #4A4A4A; border-top: 1px solid #D5E3EF; background-color: #FFFFFF;">
    <strong style="color: #4682B4; font-weight: 700;">On the Floor:</strong> Always check the physical carton count against your Purchase Order before signing the driver's delivery note.
  </div>
</div>
```
